question: Which musical instrument is played by Pt. Ravi Shankar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pt. Ravi Shankar** is renowned for playing the **Sitar**.
 
• The Sitar is a plucked stringed instrument used in Indian classical music.
 
• It is known for its distinctive sound and is one of the most popular instruments in Indian music.
 
• Pt. Ravi Shankar has been instrumental in popularizing the Sitar globally, especially in the Western world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ravi Shankar** collaborated with many Western artists, including George Harrison of The Beatles, which helped bridge the gap between Indian and Western music.
 
• He has received numerous awards and honors for his contribution to music, including several Grammy Awards and the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award.
 
• His performances and compositions have had a lasting impact on both Indian and world music.
